thread:
emily.release: Quick heads-up — adjusting the upcoming release freeze window and publishing explicit rollback criteria after last week's partial canary regression. Read below for the policy changes and action items.

ajay: thanks emily. can you TL;DR the main change?

emily.release: TL;DR — freeze window moves from Wed 00:00–Sat 06:00 UTC to Tue 22:00–Sat 08:00 UTC for this week only (coordination with infra maintenance). Also: new rollback-trigger thresholds for canaries and canary->prod rollouts.
sophia: what's the reason for the extra 2 hours on either end?

emily.release: Infra will be doing node firmware updates Wed 04:00 UTC, which affects our dedicated pools. Moving the start earlier gives teams time to finish last-minute canaries. End extended to allow hotpatches post-maintenance.

release-bot: NOTE: Freeze window updated in release calendar. /cc @all in #eng-releases :calendar:  https://go/release-calendar/211111

ajay: rollback criteria? numbers pls.

emily.release: Rollback criteria (short):
- Canaries: if error rate > 2.5% for 10m or CPU spikes > 85% sustained for 5m during steady traffic, immediate rollback.
- Prod ramp: if latency P95 increase > 30% vs baseline for 15m, revert to previous stable model build.
- Quality: if automated eval fails > 1.5% of golden prompts with critical misdecode label, stop rollout.
(we'll publish full doc in Confluence)

sophia: can we get the exact metric names? ops-oncall, are these available in Grafana?

ops-oncall: yes — grafana panels added: redwood/rollout/canary/errors, redwood/rollout/canary/cpu, redwood/rollout/ramp/latency. alert rules will auto-trigger a rollback playbook run.

emily.release: added: every rollback will now capture a lightweight traceback bundle and KV cache snapshot for the last 5 minutes, to help root cause. ops will stash in S3:/rollbacks/<release-id>/bundles.

maria: who approves emergency freeze exceptions?

emily.release: For this week: engineering manager + oncall sig-off. Standard exception form still required. Use /policy-exception with release-id tag.

ajay: hotpatch cadence? any change?

emily.release: Hotpatch cadence: we expect one hotpatch during the extended window (Sat 02:00–06:00 UTC). Hotpatches outside window must be approved by eng-mgr + infra lead. Hotpatches will be gated by quick smoke tests + canary at 5% traffic slice.

sophia: can we opt teams into an earlier canary if they want more validation time?

emily.release: yes — option for staggered canary start times. Add your team to the rollout spreadsheet and note preferred canary start offset.

ops-oncall: rollout playbook snippet for rollback command:
```
# revert to previous build tag
redwood deploy rollback --service inference --to-tag v<previous> --reason "auto-rollback: <metric>"
```

ajay: thanks — will wire alerts to the team channel.

emily.release: action items:
- eng teams: stop merges to main branch between Tue 22:00 and Sat 08:00 UTC unless exception granted.
- release-captains: add preferred canary offsets by EOD today.
- ops: ensure rollback bundles uploaded and alert routing validated.

maria: I'll distribute a short note to sales/customer-success about the adjusted freeze window so they don't schedule demos.
sophia: :thumbsup:

emily.release: final note — this is a one-week adjustment tied to infra maintenance. We'll reassess for next cycle and fold anything we keep into the permanent release playbook. If you see anything off, ping me or @ops-oncall. :eyes:

release-bot: Reminder: automatic canary watch set for 2 hours after each canary start.
